audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for pericope adulterae as later textual tradition, light of world, testimony/Father, lifting up, truth/free, ancestry dispute, adversarial father imagery, glory, Abraham, and ego eimi climax.

textual_note: John 7:53-8:11 is widely recognized as a later textual tradition absent from many early manuscripts. It is included here bracketed as a received tradition, not treated as part of the earliest recoverable Johannine text.

verses.restored: [[But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.]]

familiar.text: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

verses.restored: [[At early dawn he came again into the temple, and all the people were coming to him; sitting down, he taught them.]]

familiar.text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

verses.restored: [[The scribes and Pharisees bring a woman caught in adultery, and standing her in the middle,]]

familiar.text: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

verses.restored: [[they say to him, Teacher, this woman has been caught in the act of adultery.]]

familiar.text: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

verses.restored: [[In the Law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say?]]

familiar.text: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

verses.restored: [[They said this testing him, so that they might have something to accuse him. But Jesus bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground.]]

familiar.text: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

verses.restored: [[As they continued questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, Let the sinless one among you be first to cast a stone at her.]]

familiar.text: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

verses.restored: [[Again he bent down and wrote on the ground.]]

familiar.text: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

verses.restored: [[Hearing this, they went out one by one, beginning from the elders, and he was left alone, with the woman in the middle.]]

familiar.text: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

verses.restored: [[Jesus straightened up and said to her, Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?]]

familiar.text: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

verses.restored: [[She said, No one, Lord. Jesus said, Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on do not continue in misalignment.]]

familiar.text: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

verses.restored: Again therefore Jesus spoke to them, saying, I am the light of the world; the one following me will certainly not walk in darkness but will have the light of life.

familiar.text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

verses.restored: The Pharisees therefore said to him, You bear witness concerning yourself; your witness is not true/valid.

familiar.text: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to them, Even if I bear witness concerning myself, my witness is true, because I know from where I came and where I am going; but you do not know from where I come or where I am going.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

verses.restored: You judge according to ordinary human appearance; I judge no one in that way.

familiar.text: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

verses.restored: But even if I judge, my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the Father who sent me.

familiar.text: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

verses.restored: In your Law it has been written that the witness of two humans is true.

familiar.text: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

verses.restored: I am the one bearing witness concerning myself, and the Father who sent me bears witness concerning me.

familiar.text: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

verses.restored: They were saying to him, Where is your Father? Jesus answered, You know neither me nor my Father; if you knew me, you would know my Father also.

familiar.text: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

verses.restored: These words he spoke in the treasury, teaching in the temple, and no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.

familiar.text: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

verses.restored: He said again to them, I am going away, and you will seek me, and in your sin/misalignment you will die; where I am going, you are not able to come.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

verses.restored: The Judeans therefore said, Will he kill himself, because he says, Where I am going, you are not able to come?

familiar.text: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

verses.restored: He said to them, You are from below; I am from above. You are from this world; I am not from this world.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.restored: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins/misalignments; for unless you trust that I am, you will die in your sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

verses.restored: They were saying to him, Who are you? Jesus said to them, What I have been saying to you from the beginning.

familiar.text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

verses.restored: I have many things to speak and judge concerning you, but the One who sent me is true, and what I heard from him, these things I speak into the world.

familiar.text: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

verses.restored: They did not know that he was speaking to them of the Father.

familiar.text: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore said, When you lift up the Son of Humanity, then you will know that I am, and I do nothing from myself, but just as the Father taught me, these things I speak.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

verses.restored: The One who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, because I always do the things pleasing to him.

familiar.text: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

verses.restored: As he was speaking these things, many trusted into him.

familiar.text: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore said to the Judeans who had trusted him, If you remain in my word, you are truly my disciples.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

verses.restored: You will know the truth, and the truth will free you.

familiar.text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

verses.restored: They answered him, We are seed of Abraham and have never been enslaved to anyone; how do you say, You will become free?

familiar.text: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

verses.restored: Jesus answered them, Amen, amen, I say to you: everyone practicing sin/misalignment is enslaved to sin/misalignment.

familiar.text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

verses.restored: The enslaved one does not remain in the house into the age; the son remains into the age.

familiar.text: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

verses.restored: If therefore the Son frees you, you will truly be free.

familiar.text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

verses.restored: I know that you are seed of Abraham; yet you seek to kill me, because my word has no room in you.

familiar.text: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

verses.restored: What I have seen with the Father, I speak; and you therefore do what you heard from your father.

familiar.text: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

verses.restored: They answered and said to him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus says to them, If you are children of Abraham, do the works of Abraham.

familiar.text: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

verses.restored: But now you seek to kill me, a human who has spoken to you the truth that I heard from the Divine. This Abraham did not do.

familiar.text: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

verses.restored: You do the works of your father. They said to him, We were not born from sexual immorality; we have one Father, the Divine.

familiar.text: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

verses.restored: Jesus said to them, If the Divine were your Father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from the Divine; for I have not come from myself, but that One sent me.

familiar.text: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

verses.restored: Why do you not know my speech? Because you are not able to hear my word.

familiar.text: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

verses.restored: You are from your father, the adversarial one, and you desire to do the desires of your father. That one was a human-killer from the beginning and has not stood in the truth, because truth is not in him. When he speaks falsehood, he speaks from his own, because he is false and father of it.

familiar.text: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

verses.restored: But because I speak the truth, you do not trust me.

familiar.text: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

verses.restored: Who among you exposes me concerning sin/misalignment? If I speak truth, why do you not trust me?

familiar.text: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

verses.restored: The one being from the Divine hears the words of the Divine; because of this you do not hear, because you are not from the Divine.

familiar.text: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

verses.restored: The Judeans answered and said to him, Do we not say rightly that you are a Samaritan and have a troubling spirit?

familiar.text: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

verses.restored: Jesus answered, I do not have a troubling spirit, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

familiar.text: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

verses.restored: I do not seek my glory; there is One seeking and judging.

familiar.text: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: if anyone keeps my word, that one will certainly not behold death into the age.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

verses.restored: The Judeans said to him, Now we know you have a troubling spirit. Abraham died, and the prophets, and you say, If anyone keeps my word, that one will certainly not taste death into the age.

familiar.text: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

verses.restored: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets died. Whom do you make yourself?

familiar.text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

verses.restored: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing; my Father is the one glorifying me, of whom you say, He is our Divine.

familiar.text: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

verses.restored: Yet you have not known him, but I know him. If I said that I do not know him, I would be false like you; but I know him and keep his word.

familiar.text: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

verses.restored: Abraham your father rejoiced that he would see my day; he saw it and was glad.

familiar.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

verses.restored: The Judeans therefore said to him, You do not yet have fifty years, and you have seen Abraham?

familiar.text: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

verses.restored: Jesus said to them, Amen, amen, I say to you: before Abraham came into being, I am.

familiar.text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

verses.restored: Therefore they picked up stones to throw at him; but Jesus was hidden and went out from the temple.

familiar.text: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
